name: Default
shortDescription: Free and open source machine translation API with a web UI, running offline on the server's CPU with Argos Translate language models.

alerts.message: On first start the container downloads the language models listed in LT_LOAD_ONLY before the web UI and API answer, which can take several minutes. To add languages, edit LT_LOAD_ONLY (comma-separated language codes) and redeploy; models already downloaded stay installed.
